summary: Blue Moon: operator + its ResNexus page confirm $51 incl tax (~$46.50 before), 20/30/50 A full hookups, pull-throughs to 70 ft, laundry/wifi; 9 pull-through sites sold nightly on ResNexus; mixed nightly/extended-stay (workforce-oriented) park; price gate passes only on the 'incl tax' wording.
flags: PRICE GATE (borderline, reviewer): the operator's home page says '$51/night (incl tax)', which is ~$46.50 before McMinn County's 9.75% - passes. ResNexus shows the same '$51.00 / night' as its Standard Rate; I did not go to checkout, so whether ResNexus adds tax on top was not seen. If it does, the base rate is $51 and over the gate: no Good Sam Park (directory false), no gateway within 40 km (GSMNP 79 km), no member discount posted.

LONG STAY (passes on share, reviewer may weigh): 'Nightly, Weekly and Extended Stay available'; extended stays by application, rent due monthly, RVs '10 years or newer or by approval' (a 2023 rig passes), mail/package room, contact page lists distances to Denso and Watts Bar Nuclear Plant - a workforce clientele. But ResNexus sells 9 pull-through sites (02-10) by the night of the ~16 the note gives (~56%), and the home page invites 'Stop by for a night during your travels'. Google 4.4 over 262 reviews; RV Life 4*/$$.
SITES: count 16 (note-derived) not stated on any operator page; left as stored. ResNexus lists 9 nightly pull-through units, 48-70 ft.
FACILITIES: showers (note-derived) - operator says only 'Bathhouse'; left as stored.
